stage_a.generator_repair: O05 dry-tail refinement failure was removed by a numerically stable direct log(K) evaluation using log1p/expm1; constitutive equations were unchanged.

finding: Decoupling conductivity support from the derivative-consistent retention/capacity support closes the wet and dry regime failures without densifying the retention representation.
design_candidate: compact derivative-consistent theta/C Hermite representation plus independent adaptive log(K) support at abs logK error <=3e-4, exact analytical fallback for h>-1 cm.
next_gate: Robust paired end-to-end timing over the frozen 12-case material-regime matrix before any production-oriented work.
nonclaims: No whole-SWAP speedup claim is made.
Only prescribed-head lower-boundary cases are covered by the current matrix.
